## Hookshot · Allow Games Edition — AG BETA v1.7

**Source only. No game, no keys, no executable of the game.** Build it from **your own legally owned copy**. Not affiliated with Nintendo.

<p align="center"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AllGamersRD17/Hookshot-AllowGames/main/tools/allowgames/assets/allowgames-save-editor-logo.png" alt="Save Editor - Allow Games" width="560"></p>

### Allow Games Save Editor: ahora con logo, icono y .exe / now with its own logo, icon and .exe
**ES:** En la carpeta `AllowGames-SaveEditor` del zip ahora está **`AllowGames-SaveEditor.exe`**, con el icono de Allow Games.
Cierra el juego y arrastra tu `<juego>\user\save\<cuenta>\slot_NN\progress.sav` encima: le da **todo** a la partida (20
corazones, 999 rupias, magia, doble defensa, todas las espadas, escudos, túnicas, botas, objetos, máscaras, munición al máximo,
4 botellas, las piedras, los medallones y las 13 canciones) y guarda una copia de seguridad antes. No hay que instalar nada:
usa el Python del Builder. El `.bat` sigue ahí y hace lo mismo.

**EN:** The zip's `AllowGames-SaveEditor` folder now has **`AllowGames-SaveEditor.exe`** with the Allow Games icon. Close the
game and drag your `progress.sav` onto it: the slot gets everything, after a backup. Nothing to install.

Guide and how it works: [tools/allowgames](https://github.com/AllGamersRD17/Hookshot-AllowGames/tree/main/tools/allowgames).
Tested in game on Hookshot (PC); the save format is the Switch 2 game's own, so it should also work with an emulator's save
(untested).

### Also
- The menu shows **AG BETA v1.7**. The game itself is unchanged from v1.6/v1.5 (native 60, no outdoor brightness flashes).

### Updating
Accept the game's update offer at start, or download `HookshotBuilder.zip` and build into the same game folder: saves and
settings stay.
